package.name: @ignite-element/components
package.decision: Separate package, not a core subpath (Jose, Oct 8 2026, open question 12).
package.workspacePath: packages/ignite-components (proposed; Jose suggested packages/components; pnpm-workspace.yaml globs packages/*)
package.versioning: Own 0.x line, outside the changesets fixed group; private (0.0.0, unpublished) until its first 0.x release.

naming: Plain PascalCase names, no prefix. Tag names are chosen where the app registers the element (see plan §4 "Tag names").
requirement: Every component is built with ignite-element@3.0.0-beta.18: an igniteCore source from ignite-element/xstate (ports bound with XState .provide()) plus ignite-element projections (web custom element; useIgnite only where a consuming app is React; CLI and MCP through igniteTools). No React-only or Lit-only components.

rules.wave1: Used by 2+ consumer apps (DevTools counts as an app), or blocks DevTools M1.
rules.wave3: Used by one product app only; built inside that app with ignite-element; stays app-local.
rules.orderWithinWave: Consumer count (desc), then dependency depth (primitives first).
rules.graduation: A component moves into @ignite-element/components when a second app uses it. Until then it lives with its only consumer.

definitionOfDone: surfaces (web, PWA, CLI/MCP only where it maps to a command)

statusVocabulary.devtools-mock: mock only (earlier DevTools or catalog mocks, v2 to v8)
